CPU seconds are process CPU time. Process RSS is lifetime high-water including setup. CUDA workspace uses Torch allocator. GPU stream event intervals include host submission gaps, not pure kernel sums.

remaining.resident_loop: 57 active local columns, with all 63 possible local columns in analytic/skin tests; no per-column CPU world download

limitations: Two accepted steps measure equal work; gradients remain large; no convergence or accuracy acceptance.
Approved S01 and existing failed/drifting/unknown evidence retained.
Hybrid supports one continuous window and fixed shared footwear parameters; generic CPU12 retained.
Fresh GPU timings varied 9.20 to 14.72 seconds; final instrumented 14.72 s used conservatively.
Exact-on-plane synthetic consumer may change unknown-row sample_count by CPU/GPU roundoff; unknown/reason/domain residual agree; Data/build/body_foot_gpu/verification.json retains details.
Measured source snapshots keep exact runtime bytes; four checkout files restored original LF only, with byte mapping recorded.
